summary: Validated fresh-DB seed fix for AlokasiTransfer. Backend: all 17 pytest tests pass including new TestSeedReseed (POST /api/seed?force=true wipes and repopulates -> exactly 70 suppliers + 2 senders, key names/aliases verified: ANUGRAH ARGON MEDICA PT/PT.AAM, BERKAT BUDI BERSAMA/BBB NEW, 5 SUNGAI BUDI variants with TK NEW/GULA NEW/MINYAK, exactly 4 BDN aliased suppliers, no leftover Supplier A-D sample data). Idempotency: multiple seed and force=true calls keep count at 70 with unique account_numbers. Frontend: Kelola Supplier renders all 70 supplier-row-<id> entries with alias badges; searchable picker returns 5 rows for 'sungai' and 4 rows for 'bdn' as expected. Regression: existing supplier CRUD, sender-account CRUD, transaction CRUD, delete-blocked-when-txs, denormalized sync all still pass. DB left in seeded state (70 suppliers, 2 senders) as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ensure_seed_data() dedups suppliers by (name, account_number) and senders by name — correct and safe against duplicates.
POST /api/seed?force=true also wipes transactions (in addition to suppliers/sender-accounts). This is desirable for the fresh-DB simulation but callers should be aware it is destructive.
Backend uses @app.on_event('startup') which is deprecated in newer FastAPI (>=0.109). Consider migrating to lifespan handler, but not blocking.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated alias assertions to new seed set; added TestSeedReseed class with force-reseed count/data-integrity and idempotency tests)
seed_data_creation: None created manually; verified backend startup + POST /api/seed idempotently seed 70 suppliers + 2 sender accounts from /app/backend/seed_data.py. DB left seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py runs cleanly with configured `-n 2 --dist loadscope` because TestSeedReseed is in its own class (single worker) — but the destructive force-reseed still races other classes if run with different distribution. If you see intermittent 'Supplier tidak ditemukan' 404s from TestSupplierNotFoundBugRegression during xdist runs, that's the known race with TestSeedReseed's wipe; rerun serially with `-n 0` to confirm. All 17 tests pass in both configurations for me.
rca of the issue: Original bug: preview DB and production DB are separate; 70 imported suppliers only lived in preview. Fix embeds SEED_SUPPLIERS/SEED_SENDERS in /app/backend/seed_data.py and calls ensure_seed_data() on startup + POST /api/seed. Idempotent dedup by (name, account_number) for suppliers and by name for senders prevents duplicates on repeated startups. Verified end-to-end that fresh/force-reseeded DB yields exactly 70 suppliers and 2 senders matching the real directory.
